meta.name: Dexter: Resurrection
meta.description: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

videos.title: A Beating Heart...
videos.overview: Dexter Morgan awakens from a ten-week coma.

videos.title: Camera Shy
videos.overview: Dexter tracks down a serial killer in NYC as Harrison spirals from guilt.

videos.title: Backseat Driver
videos.overview: Dexter must carefully balance attempts to help get him acclimated.

videos.title: Call Me Red
videos.overview: Dexter attends a mysterious gathering as Harrison struggles at work.

videos.title: Murder Horny
videos.overview: Harrison's fears escalate as Dexter pursues a dangerous connection.

videos.title: Cats & Mouse
videos.overview: As Dexter closes in on a murderer, Harrison faces a crisis of identity.

videos.title: Course Correction
videos.overview: Dexter learns unsettling information as Harrison contemplates his future.

videos.title: The Kill Room Where It Happens
videos.overview: Dexter redirects his attention as a way to step up as a father.

videos.title: Touched by an Ángel
videos.overview: Prater and Charley's revelation forces Dexter to go to extreme lengths.

videos.title: And Justice for All...
videos.overview: Dexter and Harrison face the consequences of their darkness.

videos.title: Risky Business
videos.overview: Dexter struggles to find purpose beyond the hunt as Harrison begins his NYPD career. A brazen new murderer puts the city on edge.

videos.title: Fallen
videos.overview: Dexter navigates his mid-life crisis as The Five Borough Killer grips NYC.

videos.title: Live Free and Die
videos.overview: Dexter closes in on a ruthless killer terrorizing the city, but a fleeting clue is all he has to go on.

videos.title: Young Blood
videos.overview: Dexter probes a young killer's legacy and must decide if the Code applies.

videos.title: Out Of The Past
videos.overview: A familiar face from Dexter's past resurfaces, challenging him intensely. The hunt for The Five Borough Killer intensifies across New York.
